profile.headline: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer I 12 YOE I Python, React, GIS I AI/LLM I AWS, GCP, Azure
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 12+ years of experience building software across environmental, healthcare, and restaurant tech. Specialized in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), API design, AI/LLM technologies, and automation, I focus on creating solutions that are simple and maintainable.

My specialty of combining nature's patterns with applied science and technology reveals many hidden nuances in the conversation around food, health, and climate. I'm currently looking for remote-first opportunities in the US, preferably in data-heavy domains like ag-tech.

Contact: paulng91@gmail.com

Skills:
 - Programming Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Clojure, Java, HTML, CSS
 - Tools and Frameworks: AWS, Azure, GCP, PostGIS, Claude, Gemini, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Git, React, Linux, CLI, Terminal, PowerShell

positions.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Reviewed and corrected over 1000 AI-generated code responses, enhancing model reliability in debugging and algorithmic reasoning.  
• Designed prompts and evaluation criteria to boost AI performance in software engineering tasks.  
• Analyzed failure patterns to recommend improvements, reducing coding errors and strengthening technical reasoning.

positions.description:
